node.title: [Free Nodelet Hack] CodeMirror
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You need to be logged in, then enable the Free Nodelet in your [id://25185], turn on the option "Code Wrapping Off" in your [id://450961], and in your [id://492700], paste the following, and all textareas and code blocks will become [https://codemirror.net/|CodeMirror] editors with syntax highlighting, line numbers, etc. For code blocks, the syntax highlighter is Perl (which doesn't appear to mess up the syntax highlighting on non-Perl source too much), and for text areas, the syntax highlighting is HTML, with support for JavaScript in

(If you've already got jQuery loaded from another nodelet hack, you don't need to put that .

I've created [https://gist.github.com/haukex/33da4e0d4f3c7a1e2be8d1cffe75dc76#file-pm_codemirror-js|a Gist] to version-control this code. I'll consider this particular node a "living document", as in I'm not going to add an "Updated" tag every time I make a change - if you want the version history, see [https://gist.github.com/haukex/33da4e0d4f3c7a1e2be8d1cffe75dc76/revisions|the Gist].

"use strict"; $(function () { $("") .appendTo("body"); var opts = { lineNumbers: true, indentWithTabs: true, tabSize: 4, indentUnit: 4, viewportMargin: Infinity, lineWrapping: true, mode: { name: "htmlmixed", // text/html tags: { style: [ ["type", /^text\/(x-)?scss$/, "text/x-scss"], [null, null, "css"] ], script: [[null, null, "text/javascript"]], c: [[null, null, "text/x-perl"]] } } }; if ( window["CM_THEME"] ) opts.theme = window.CM_THEME; var opts_codeblock = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(opts)); // deep copy opts_codeblock['readOnly'] = true; opts_codeblock['mode'] = 'text/x-perl'; $('textarea').each(function () { var myCodeMirror = CodeMirror.fromTextArea(this, opts); }); $('.codeblock:has(.codetext)').each(function () { var div = this; var text = $(div).text().trimEnd(); var myCodeMirror = CodeMirror( function(elt) { div.parentNode.replaceChild(elt, div); }, opts_codeblock); myCodeMirror.setValue(text); }); });
